BiblicalUsage: Nalah means to complete or to finish, to bring a thing to its end, and its only occurrence is a spoiler being spoiled. In Isaiah 33:1 woe is pronounced on the one that spoils and was not spoiled, and that deals treacherously when none dealt treacherously with him, for when he shall cease to spoil, he shall be spoiled.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the spoiler's end is written into the spoiling itself; what goes around in Isaiah 33:1 comes around, and the finishing belongs to God.
